name: VC Book Appointment
description: Receives APPOINTMENT_DATA JSON from the inbound router, creates a Google Calendar event in the service department calendar, emails a confirmation to the customer, and sends an internal notification to the service desk.

mapper.subject: Your Service Appointment at Valley Chevrolet — {{formatDate(2.preferred_date, "MMM D, YYYY")}}
mapper.content:
Hi {{2.customer_name}},

Your service appointment has been confirmed!

Date:{{formatDate(2.preferred_date, "dddd, MMMM D, YYYY")}}
Time:{{if(2.preferred_time == "morning", "8:00 AM", if(2.preferred_time == "afternoon", "1:00 PM", 2.preferred_time))}}
Vehicle:{{2.vehicle}}
Service:{{2.service_requested}}
Location:700 Kidder Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702

{{if(2.loaner_needed == true, "A loaner vehicle has been noted on your reservation — subject to availability.", "")}}

If you need to reschedule or have any questions, please call us at (570) 823-XXXX.

We look forward to seeing you and your {{2.vehicle}}!

Valley Chevrolet Service Center
700 Kidder Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702

mapper.subject: [NEW APPT] {{2.customer_name}} — {{2.vehicle}} — {{formatDate(2.preferred_date, "MMM D")}}
mapper.content:
New Appointment Booked via AI Receptionist

Customer:{{2.customer_name}}
Phone:{{2.phone}}
Email:{{2.email}}
Vehicle:{{2.vehicle}} — {{2.mileage}} miles
Service:{{2.service_requested}}
Date/Time:{{formatDate(2.preferred_date, "dddd, MMMM D, YYYY")}} — {{2.preferred_time}}
Drop-off:{{2.drop_off}}
Loaner needed:{{2.loaner_needed}}
Notes:{{2.notes}}

_setup_variables.APPOINTMENT_WEBHOOK_ID: Replace with Make webhook ID after creating the webhook
_setup_variables.SERVICE_CALENDAR_ID: Your Google Calendar ID for the service department (e.g. abc123@group.calendar.google.com)
_setup_variables.GMAIL_CONNECTION_ID: Your Gmail connection ID in Make
